title: OL-20261115-16: Door A: web launcher that puts a live preview online with no terminal (US-SPEC-19) (workers#19)
body:
**Owner:** executor

Moved from ultrastable/workers#19 (DRAIN-FLEET-1). Worker that asks the US-SPEC-16 questions, shows the licence summary and Cloudflare terms, uses the temporary-accounts REST API and returns an address plus a private claim link.
